description: This source file defines a class 'VectorStorePreCallHook' that acts as a hook for pre-processing and post-processing LLM calls involving vector store searches. It handles extracting queries from messages, performing vector store searches, appending search results as context, and embedding search results into responses and streaming chunks.

classes.name: VectorStorePreCallHook
classes.description: A custom logger class that manages vector store searches before LLM calls, appending contextual info from vector search results, and embedding these results into responses and streaming data.
